Choose **MZT Player → Check for Updates…** to compare your installed version with the latest stable GitHub release. If a newer version is available, the app asks before opening the matching download in your browser. Updates are not downloaded or installed automatically.

Download **MZT-Player-1.6.0-macOS-arm64.zip** for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains the archive checksum. The build is ad hoc signed and not Apple-notarised.
